pc_changelog:
v4.1.0 — UI Polish, Widget Stability & Virtual Desktop Fix

• Removed large 'Clipboard' header — maximized clip list space
• Fixed red DWM window border when focused
• Clip card borders now transparent (no more red tint artifacts)
• Taskbar widget: position caching eliminates flickering
• Virtual desktop support: Expand opens on current desktop
• Compact search bar with inline item count
android_changelog:
v4.1.0 — Smart Sync & File Discovery

• Search bar + category filters (Text, Images, Docs) for quick clip access
• Native MediaStore document scanner — finds PDFs, docs, APKs on all Android devices
• Simplified sync: first connect waits silently, no history dump
• Smart dedup: duplicates move to top instead of being ignored
• Redownload App button in Settings
• Improved Redmi/MIUI file scanning compatibility
